Name: Less Saturated Visuals
Author: Phiido
Description:
[b][size=4]Feature[/size][/b]
Simply enough, this mod desaturates ingame assets!
It does this in a non-destructive manner by adding a desaturated and transparent image as overlay using Content Patcher.

All official languages in regards of visuals are included!
These include English, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Italian, French, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.

With the config file you can choose between five different strength levels of how desaturation should be done (default is 20).
This is done by reusing a single desaturated and transparent image (for each asset) and adding them ontop of eachother several times.
(This caused a decrease in brightness so I've increased brightness a bit in each image).
There is a limitation to this method as transparancy works multiplicatively and will quickly hit a roof (as well increasing code and load time).

[b][size=4]Notice![/size][/b]
Currently only vanilla Stardew Valley is supported!

It would probably still work with smaller irregularites with mods that only do recoloring.
If lightness or darkness is very different in mod visuals it might cause poor contrast.
Otherwise it will look weird with any mod that replaces vanilla assets with custom shapes/assets.

As this mod is heavily code-dependant, each level of strength adds about 4 seconds of load time (for my computer). So choosing a strength of 50 will increase load time with about 20 seconds.
Depending on hardware it may be more.
